mapper.select: select count(1) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_goods_jingdong_dropshipping where sku_id = #{supplierGoodsId} and shop_id = #{shopId} and is_delete = 0
select common_id,spu_id,goods_id,sku_id,shop_id,is_delete from ${database.prefix.order}hou_goods_jingdong_dropshipping where sku_id = #{commonIdStr} and shop_id = #{shopId} and is_delete = 0

select gjd.common_id,gjd.spu_id,gjd.goods_id,gjd.sku_id,gjd.shop_id,gb.goods_name from ${database.prefix.order}hou_goods_jingdong_dropshipping gjd left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb on gjd.goods_id = gb.goods_id where gjd.goods_id = #{goodsId} and gjd.is_delete = 0

select og.order_goods_num as goodsNum, gjd.sku_id as supplierGoodsId from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_goods_jingdong_dropshipping gjd on og.goods_id = gjd.goods_id where og.order_id = #{orderId}

#{skuId}

select gjd.goods_id from ${database.prefix.order}hou_goods_jingdong_dropshipping gjd left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og on gjd.goods_id = og.goods_id left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob on ob.order_id = og.order_id where ob.jd_order_id = #{param.parentJdOrderId} and gjd.sku_id = #{param.skuId} and ob.shop_id = gjd.shop_id

select oor.return_method_status from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base og left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor on og.order_id = oor.order_id where ob.jd_order_id = #{jdOrderId} or jd_son_order_id = #{jdOrderId} limit 1

select gc.common_name,gc.common_image,gc.cat_name,gjd.spu_id as supplyCommonId from ${database.prefix.order}hou_goods_jingdong_dropshipping gjd left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on gjd.common_id = gc.common_id where gc.common_name is not null
and gc.common_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.commonName},'%')
group by gjd.spu_id
